intro1.text: Header in two rows (☰, vessel name; LIVE chip, berth and date, Ask, Map). Tab bar: Snapshot, Decks, ＋ Log in the center, Hourly, Plan. Nothing floats over the content.

about.text:
Complete set of the app’s screens and sheets in the build #29 / #30 design: one type scale (13 / 15 / 17 / 22 / 28), one card, two buttons, orange only for the action that matters. Screens where you type or tap are shown in more than one state, with their tap targets listed. Sample numbers in the shape of Hera Highway 13A at 15:04 (1,352 autos, 337 left); nothing here is real data. Each phone scrolls. The buttons at the top switch every phone to Night or Extra visible, and outline every tap target.

The Look tweaks on each screen switch it to Night or Extra visible, or outline its tap targets. The sample VIN is blurred.

Not drawn
iOS system sheets the app opens (share sheet, camera, photo picker, file picker): Apple’s own screens.
Siri “Log a count in VSA”: it only opens Log › Hourly filled in, shown above.
Lock screen / Dynamic Island, Siri answers, mic: approved for later, not designed yet.

cap5_4.text: Customize Snapshot. Reorder, send a box to Plan / Hourly / Decks, or hide it. Saved on this phone.

cap6_1.text: Finish history. From the Finish tile. How the forecast moved after each hour.

cap6_2.text: Closeout. Ticks (each opens what to fix), the forecast scorecard, one question, the answer sheet, and Mark complete last.

cap6_3.text: Vessel complete. A clean Yes needs no open items; otherwise “anyway” with a reason. Reopen needs a reason; the log keeps every mark.

intro6.text: The end of a ship: how the forecast moved, the closeout checklist, and Colby’s complete mark.

cap7_1.text: New vessel. Take or choose a photo; or a file, pasted text, or typing. A saved draft offers Resume.

cap7_2.text: Game plan read. The ship as read, doubts with the exact difference (never a corrected number), and what’s missing.

cap7_3.text: Paste text. ChatGPT-VSA deck lines. Totals are checked; a mismatch shows the difference. Opens the steps as a draft.

cap7_4.text: Step 1 · Vessel. Name, date, LIVE or TEST, berth. Step 2 (Start) is the planned start time, breaks 12:00 and 18:00, and the shift end with its side.

cap7_5.text: Step 3 · Cargo to destinations. Pick a destination; side and clear-by come from the terminal directory, never typed.

cap7_6.text: Step 4 · Decks. Height, quantity per hatch, brand split per deck. A bare “D” deck name is refused.

cap7_7.text: Step 5 · Load list. Typed or read from a photo; mismatches show the exact difference and a choice.

cap7_8.text: Step 6 · Review. Everything in one place, notes to carry to Plan, “I have seen this”, then Save. The vessel is created only here.

cap7_9.text: Close this setup? Shown on ✕ with typed values. Discard cannot be undone.

intro7.text: Photo first. Every path lands on the same six steps (Vessel, Start, Cargo to destinations, Decks, Load list, Review); nothing is saved until Review.

cap8_1.text: Vans. One row per van: status, driver, gas. Bulk “Mark Back vans gassed”.

cap8_2.text: Van row. Edits keep the earlier values; remove keeps it in the log, marked removed.

cap8_3.text: Read the van sheet. On-phone text reading; tick what to add.

cap8_4.text: Paperwork photos. From Plan › Baseline status (only when “Keep game plan photos” is on).

intro8.text: Opened from Plan. Van checkout and gassing, read from the van sheet photo or typed.

title9.text: 9 · States: break, end of shift, first launch, Night

cap9_1.text: Break / end of shift. Ship must equal field, overall and by brand: match green, ship ahead orange, field ahead red. (Overall and brand banners shown together for reference.)

cap9_2.text: First launch. No sample data; values only from paperwork or Colby.

cap9_3.text: Night. Same layout, Night palette (7:1 contrast). Use the Night and Extra visible buttons at the top to see every screen in each.

intro9.text: The same screens when the ship must equal the field, when nothing is open yet, and at night.

cap2_1b.text: Log › After Save. The answer after every Save: what the count changed and the new finish forecast (labeled FORECAST). Silence when nothing moved.

cap1_2b.text: Snapshot, break coming. 30 min before a break the Now card says when to stop, with a quiet See DK12 button (not peach: nothing to log). Sample numbers, not the Main story. Finish 15:25 is a FORECAST that skips the 11:45 stop and the 12:00 break.

cap1_4b.text: Needed rate when pace is below it: orange outline, number and tick, and one plain line. Never peach, never FORECAST. Example numbers, not today’s ship.

cap3_1b.text: Deck sheet › After Save. What the deck save changed (ship progress, remaining, percent) and the field gap as in transit. Quiet line when nothing needs attention; peach Update decks only when decks are older than the last logged hour. Sample numbers: DK12 160 → 148.

cap1_4c.text: Needed rate when pace is only just above it (needed at least 0.9× pace): same orange warning, line "Close: pace is only N/hr above what the ship needs." Example numbers, not today’s ship.
